data.name: Unbroken Stride
data.description: An impervious messenger draws upon his bardic abilities to imbue himself with grace and speed. While using this bardic performance, an impervious messenger gains a +%1 insight bonus on all Acrobatics, Climb, Fly, and Ride checks. In addition, while maintaining this performance, he gains the benefits of the ranger's woodland stride ability and a +10-foot enhancement bonus to his base land speed.|BardLVL/2|UnbrokenStrideBonus
